cues.en: The problem we're facing currently in the app is that we're not always seeing our latest place and that
has something to do with a behavior by Ionic pages which I covered earlier in the course.
They are cached and therefore, if I reload the app whilst I'm on a new app offer page, the other pages
haven't been visited yet and therefore they're not cached and hence if I add a new place here, we don't
have that problem we have otherwise because now if I submit this, we actually reach these other pages for
the first time and therefore for our offers page and also for the discover page, ngOnInit will
run when we visit them.
If we however reload the app whilst we're on this page here, on the discover page and then we go to offers
and then we add a new place,
then we have visited both discover and offers and they're both in the cache because we never pop them
off of our page stack,
we only added new pages on top and hence when we add a new place here and we come back, we don't see
our place here or here because we're still using the old cached version and therefore ngOnInit
never runs again and check the routing module in this course if that doesn't tell you anything,
